notes: SUMMARY: Aurum is a regulated fintech (EU HQ) evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for customer-facing support assistant + doc summarization for regulated customers.
Primary security focus: encryption posture and key ownership. CISO wants BYOK/HSM, signed audit trail, and strict data residency (EU only).

In-transit: must support mutual TLS (mTLS) between customer agents and control plane + internal mTLS for service-to-service. TLS 1.3 minimum. Prefer short-lived certs and automated rotation (cert-manager / SPIFFE suggested).

Client auth: they prefer client certificates issued from their private CA (or integration with Vault PKI). Need option to upload CA bundle or use Redwood-managed intermediate issued from customer root.

At-rest: AES-256-GCM envelope encryption. Customer requires CMEK (customer-managed encryption keys) stored in their cloud account. Support for AWS KMS with CloudHSM backing, Azure Key Vault HSM, and Google Cloud KMS requested.

Key lifecycle: explicit requirement for automatic rotation plus ability to perform manual re-key and emergency key revocation. Rotation cadence preference: quarterly; must support re-encryption without downtime or with documented rolling rekey procedure.
Secrets management: prefer integration with HashiCorp Vault for short-lived tokens. Do not permit long-lived plaintext secrets in config. Support for secure retrieval via IAM role + mTLS recommended.
Key wrapping / envelope model: they insist on RH-side usage of customer KEKs only; Redwood should only see wrapped DEKs. Provide sample flow for envelope encryption and KMS call graphs.

Audit logging: all KMS operations, config changes, and admin actions must be forwarded to their SIEM (Splunk) with integrity metadata. Logs must be tamper-evident and stored in EU region; retention policy 7 years for audit trail (or as required by regs).

Data residency: no backups or replicas permitted outside EU; snapshot lifecycle must be constrained and documented. They asked for explicit 'data never leaves region' attestations for POC environment.
Network: private endpoints only (no public internet ingress). VPC peering preferred; Transit Gateway acceptable with strict route table controls. Need static egress IPs for allowlisting.
encryption_posture_summary: Customer requires strong in-transit and at-rest guarantees: mTLS for all ingress/internal comms (TLS1.3), envelope encryption with AES-256-GCM, CMEK/BYOK via CloudHSM or Key Vault, automated and manual rotation workflows, integration with Vault for secrets, and EU-only residency + signed, forwardable audit logs. Redwood must provide architecture diagrams, rotation runbook, and sample KMS ARNs for POC.
